name: HD 19467

planets.name: B
planets.note: benchmark T-dwarf companion (~50-70 MJup) at ~1.6" (~51 au); found via a long-term RV trend + Keck/NIRC2 imaging (Crepp et al. 2014); later JWST-imaged

paper.title: The TRENDS High-contrast Imaging Survey. V. Discovery of an Old and Cold Benchmark T-dwarf Orbiting the Nearby G-star HD 19467

notes: Old solar-analog G3V star hosting the benchmark T-dwarf companion HD 19467 B (RV-trend-selected, discovered in Keck/NIRC2 imaging; Crepp+2014), later also a JWST coronagraphy target.
